rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: Global filters apply to catalogs unless a catalog overrides them. Later layers win.
rules.catalogScopeNote: These settings apply to catalog rows. Search-only filters live under Sources → Search.
rules.section.certificationHint: Hide titles rated above this limit. Movies and series only when the provider exposes certification.
rules.section.adultHint: Hide adult titles and mature anime marked as adult by providers (SFW-oriented catalogs).
rules.section.digitalReleaseHint: Hide movies that are not digitally released yet. Applies to catalog rows only.
rules.section.unreleasedHint: Hide titles that have not been released yet based on release date. Applies to catalog rows only.
rules.section.exclusionHint: Hide catalog items that match any excluded genre or keyword in title, overview, or keywords.
rules.searchScopeTip: Tip: filters that should affect search only belong on Sources → Search — catalog rules do not change text search automatically.
rules.digitallyReleasedOnly: Hide undigitally released movies in catalogs
rules.excludeKeywordsHint: Comma-separated words matched in title, overview, or keywords.
rules.minimumRatingHint: Accepted range: 0 to 10. Leave empty for no rating floor.
rules.minimumVotesHint: Minimum vote count across providers that support it. Leave empty for no floor.
rules.previewError: Could not preview rules. Check your edit credential and try again.
rules.loadError: Could not load rules from the API.
rules.warning.DIGITAL_RELEASE_UNSUPPORTE: Provider does not expose digital-release filtering
rules.warning.CERTIFICATION_UNSUPPORTED: Provider does not expose certification filtering
rules.warning.REGION_UNSUPPORTED: Provider does not support region-aware catalogs
rules.fallback.IGNORE_AT_PROVIDER: ignore region constraint at provider boundary
